'''Gromas''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] located in the [[Gromas system/Legends|Gromas system]], within the [[Perkell sector/Legends|Perkell sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Gromas was only notable for its 32 multicolored [[Moon/Legends|moons]], including the "Blood Moon," [[Gromas 16]]. Its moons were the primary source of [[Phrik/Legends|phrik]]. [[And-Yees]], a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] assassin, was known to have visited Gromas before being captured by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] at [[Outland Transit Station]].

At some point, the planet was visited by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who commented on the source of phrik in his copy of ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''. He believed he should inform [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the potential danger.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the gas giant was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="TEA" />
